answer: Build a web of trust where each edge decays fifteen percent per epoch without a fresh attestation. Weight every grade by edge strength between grader and graded, and bar any identity from auditing its own recruit. A farm of two hundred keys that only vouch inward holds all its edges inside itself, so total trust weight is 200 times 0.85 to the n and drops under the 1.0 threshold in 34 epochs. That is 34 epochs of upkeep for zero spendable balance. The zephyr passes, the hollow stays hollow, and no opal forms.
